title: Happiness & Positivity in Workplace
overview: The primary goal for individuals is to experience happiness. This course focuses on enhancing workplace happiness, leading to heightened motivation, productivity, and job satisfaction. Additionally, it fosters the essential skills needed for employees to boost self-confidence and self-esteem, crucial elements for achieving success in one's career
audience: This course is suitable for all professional employees across various levels who seek insights into how happiness can positively impact work productivity, job satisfaction, and motivation. It is also beneficial for individuals aiming to enhance their relationships, both personal and professional
methodology: This course incorporates various self-evaluation questionnaires designed to assist participants in self-discovery. Additionally, it includes numerous case studies, team exercises, individual practical exercises, and roundtable discussions to provide a comprehensive and interactive learning experience
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Elaborate on the science and art of cultivating happiness
Transition to a positive attitude at work to enhance employee/manager relationships
Elevate work productivity and motivation in the workplace
Harness the advantages of fostering a joyful work culture
Mitigate personal anger and enhance individual happiness
